newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaha forms motorbike parts company.
newsitem.headline: Yamaha forms motorbike parts company.

text.p: Yamaha Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had formed a wholly owned company in Hamamatsu, central Japan, to develop and sell customised components for use in motorcycles.
The new company, named Y's Gear Co Ltd, is capitalised at 90 million yen and will start operations in April.
Japanese overall demand for customised components for motorcycles such as suspensions, handlebars, and metres, stood at 40 billion yen, rising an annual 30 percent.

The new company will sell Yamaha-made components for motorcycles and develop original products to sell them through Yamaha's existing motorcycle sales network in Japan. It will also distribute other products in the future, such as marine products-related items and foreign-made motorcycle components.
The company aims to achieve annual sales of 1.50 billion yen in the year starting April 1997 and 2.50 billion yen in 1998/99.
